name: RTI-113
summary: RTI(-4229)-113 (2β-carbophenoxy-3β-(4-chlorophenyl)tropane) is a stimulant drug which acts as a potent and fully selective dopamine reuptake inhibitor (DRI). It has been suggested as a possible substitute drug for the treatment of cocaine addiction." Replacing the methyl ester in RTI-31 with a phenyl ester makes the resultant RTI-113 fully DAT specific.

pharmacology.text: RTI(-4229)-113 (2β-carbophenoxy-3β-(4-chlorophenyl)tropane) is a stimulant drug which acts as a potent and fully selective dopamine reuptake inhibitor (DRI). Although NRIs are known to inhibit DA reuptake in the prefrontal cortex where DATs are low in number, the fact that desipramine is not reliably self-administered makes it unlikely that NRIs are contributing to the addictive character of cocaine.

uses.text: It has been suggested as a possible substitute drug for the treatment of cocaine addiction.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Stimulants of this kind can cause a racing heart, high blood pressure, anxiety, sleeplessness, overheating and paranoia, and repeated use can lead to compulsive redosing and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。這類興奮劑可能引起心跳過快、高血壓、焦慮、失眠、體溫過高和偏執，反覆使用可能導致強迫性追加和依賴。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。这类兴奋剂可能引起心跳过快、高血压、焦虑、失眠、体温过高和偏执，反复使用可能导致强迫性追加和依赖。

fact.en: RTI-113 blocks the dopamine transporter and almost nothing else, which makes it a favourite tool for testing whether dopamine alone explains a stimulant's effects.
fact.zh: RTI-113 幾乎只阻斷多巴胺轉運蛋白，因此成為研究人員愛用的工具，用來測試單憑多巴胺是否就能解釋興奮劑的作用。
fact.zhHans: RTI-113 几乎只阻断多巴胺转运蛋白，因此成为研究人员爱用的工具，用来测试单凭多巴胺是否就能解释兴奋剂的作用。
